			scope:glorpui_sv = societal_value_type:individualism_vs_communalism
			scope:glorpui_country = {
				OR = {
					AND = { OR = { religion = religion:hussite } NOT = { AND = { OR = { religion = religion:hussite } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:adamite_services } is_ai = no } } }
					AND = { OR = { religion = religion:bogomilism religion = religion:catharism religion = religion:lollardy religion = religion:paulicianism } NOT = { AND = { OR = { religion = religion:bogomilism religion = religion:catharism religion = religion:lollardy religion = religion:paulicianism } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:adoptionism } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:modalism } } } }
					AND = { OR = { religion = religion:bogomilism } NOT = { AND = { OR = { religion = religion:bogomilism } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:holy_cooperation } } } }
					AND = { OR = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion } NOT = { AND = { OR = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:mithraic_mysteries_aspect } } } }
					AND = { OR = { religion = religion:paulicianism } NOT = { AND = { OR = { religion = religion:paulicianism } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:name_change } } } }
					AND = { OR = { religion = religion:lutheran } NOT = { AND = { OR = { religion = religion:lutheran } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:pietism } } } }
					AND = { OR = { religion = religion:catharism } NOT = { AND = { OR = { religion = religion:catharism } NOT = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:the_perfects } } } }
					AND = { custom_tooltip = { text = institute_of_noble_maidens_why OR = { tag = MOS tag = RUS } has_variable = institute_of_noble_maidens } NOT = { AND = { custom_tooltip = { text = institute_of_noble_maidens_why OR = { tag = MOS tag = RUS } has_variable = institute_of_noble_maidens } exists = capital capital = { always = no } } } }
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
}
